payload.title: Month-end scheduling

candidate.code:
import calendar
from datetime import date

def solve(args):
    current = date.fromisoformat(args['date'])
    absolute = current.year * 12 + current.month - 1 + args['months']
    year, month0 = divmod(absolute, 12)
    day = min(current.day, calendar.monthrange(year, month0 + 1)[1])
    return date(year, month0 + 1, day).isoformat()
